EQWT is a QuakeWorld tournament played only on the Endif map. The rules are based on DuelMania.pl (with slight modifications), so if you're familiar to DuelMania's rules, you'll have no problem memorizing the ones that we have. EQWT uses Double-Elimination ladder. Our main goal is fun for everybody. There are no prizes planned.

* [http://eqwt.quakeworld.pl official website]
* [http://eqwt.quakeworld.pl/?site=forum forum]
